# Abyss Audio 1.3.4
- Moved downloads and updates to their own public Abyss release channel. - Kept the Abyss Forums project and app source private. - Improved the reliability of automatic and manual update checks.

# Abyss Audio 1.3.3
- Added bass, mid, and treble EQ to every active-app volume row. - Added Bluetooth split output: keep normal Mac audio on Bluetooth while routing one selected app to Built-in Speakers. - Added an optional Bluetooth idle-sleep guard, with clear macOS lid-sleep limits. - Fixed Abyss Deck output selection and added useful messages when a saved source file is missing. - Stopped repeated System Audio permission checks after setup has already been approved. - Added a Restart Mac or Later choice after BlackHole driver installation. - Made signed update checks automatic on launch and daily, with critical-release support for incompatible old builds.

# Abyss Audio 1.3.2
- Added simple, secure in-app updates with a small release-notes window. - Added automatic update checks and an optional background-download setting. - Added **Check for Updates…** to the app menu and Settings. - Prepared signed update archives and a straightforward publishing workflow for future releases.
